text:
Sam: heads up — p95 for the batcher-backlog alert has been noisy for the last ~20m for classifier models. wondering where we should tune this or if a short mute makes sense. anyone oncall?

Priya: saw it. looks like the spike aligns with a few long requests from model-v2. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/batcher/batcher-backlog?var-model=classifier :eyes:

Jordan: pinging infra. the alert is in infra/alerts/batcher_backlog.yaml in the repo (path: https://github.com/redwood/infra/blob/main/alerts/batcher_backlog.yaml). threshold currently 100ms queue-depth p95.

Eli: quick thought — that alert is noisy during periodic rebuilds and GC on a subset of pods. we usually do a short snooze (30–60m) while root cause is investigated, or temporarily raise p95 to 150 for the classifer service.

Maya: +1 to snooze while we collect traces. can someone share which traces to look at?

Priya: trace link for a recent offending request: https://trace.redwood.internal/trace/0a1b2c3d. look at span group `batcher.enqueue` and `model-v2-inference`.

Sam: thanks — I can open a PR to bump the threshold to 150 for the classifier route and also request a 45m mute. which change do folks prefer (bump vs short mute)?

Jordan: prefer short mute + investigate. bumping threshold can mask real regressions.

Eli: agree. short mute + follow-up. If you open the mute, please include the svc and rule IDs.

Sam: opened mute request in alertmanager: `snooze: batcher-backlog: classifier: 45m` (created via https://alertmanager.redwood.internal/snoozes). oncall-bot should announce when it's active. PR to infra not needed for mute.

oncall-bot: snooze created by Sam for alert `batcher-backlog` (scope: service=classifier) — duration 45m. ID: snooze-2028-04-12-09.

Maya: :thumbsup: I'll start looking at traces and attach a small sample to the ticket.

Priya: quick FYI — if you do decide to change the alert config, update the playbook at docs/playbooks/alerts-batcher.md with reasoning and rollback steps.

Sam: noted. I'll monitor p95 and post updates here. if p95 stays high after snooze ends we'll consider a temporary threshold bump + follow-up PR.

Eli: thanks — ping me if you want me to own the post-mortem.

Sam: leaving this thread open, will post results. thanks team.
